name: lib/bulkhead
title: Bulkhead
summary: A cap on concurrent calls to one dependency, with a bounded wait queue.

config.name: max_concurrent
config.description: Calls that may run at once.

operations.description: A queued call takes a free slot.
A queued call gave up waiting.

invariants.text: Zero capacity is refused, never divided by.
Slots fill, then the queue, then calls are rejected.
A released slot goes to the queue.
A queued call giving up is not a rejection.
A double release does not underflow.
